copy.headline: Tarrant Area Food Bank hosts Thanksgiving mega food distribution at AT&T Stadium
copy.caption:
The Tarrant Area Food Bank and the Goodyear Cotton Bowl Classic are distributing food to 5,000 families at AT&T Stadium on Thursday morning. A Tarrant area food bank is working to make sure families in need have a meal this Thanksgiving.

FOX 4's Alex Boyer has more. ARLINGTON, Texas - The Tarrant Area Food Bank is partnering with the Goodyear Cotton Bowl Classic to provide Thanksgiving meals to more than 5,000 North Texas families.

story.title: Tarrant Area Food Bank hosts Thanksgiving mega food distribution at AT&T Stadium
story.summary: The Tarrant Area Food Bank and the Goodyear Cotton Bowl Classic are distributing food to 5,000 families at AT&T Stadium on Thursday morning. A Tarrant area food bank is working to make sure families in need have a meal this Thanksgiving. FOX 4's Alex Boyer has more. ARLINGTON, Texas - The Tarrant Area Food Bank is partnering with the Goodyear Cotton Bowl Classic to provide Thanksgiving meals to more than 5,000 North Texas families. The organizations are hosting a massive food distribution event Thursday morning outside AT&T Stadium in Arlington. The seventh annual Thanksgiving Mega Mobile Market runs from 8 a.m. to noon, or until supplies run out. Volunteers are handing out food in Lot 4, just east of the stadium near the corner of Cowboys Way and AT&T Way. The event is free and open to anyone who needs it.
